mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines over the horizon, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 8% triggers optimism about labor market strength, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 8%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust expansion, enhancing market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 > 12000 and INDPRO > 95.0 over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high demand (GDPC1) and low rates (FEDFUNDS) may indicate peak growth, compressing future returns as markets anticipate slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 12000 and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 2% triggers concerns about cost pressures, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) alongside low unemployment (UNRATE) signals economic strength, driving short-term positive returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No positive 5d returns when both PAYEMS > 132344 and UNRATE < 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO) with controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) suggests sustainable growth, boosting market confidence and generating positive returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 95.5 and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tightening, increasing discount rates and lowering equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% over the horizon.
